title: Chief of Staff - Virtual Assembly Line (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°
 At  1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision:  Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?  
 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. 
 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow . 
 Learn  more about our Product & Tech team! 
Your mission
 As Chief of Staff - Virtual Assembly Line (VAL), you will serve as a strategic right hand to the VP Product & Engineering for Growth & Operation and play a central role in driving alignment, operational excellence, and strategic execution across our global tech organization. You will act as the vital link between our technical development, our international markets, and our primary customers in the growth teams and the craft businesses. From alignment with C-Level and investor relations to fostering a high-performance team culture, you ensure the department operates at peak efficiency.
This is a highly visible and hands-on position, combining strategic thinking with deep operational involvement. You’ll work across multiple product areas, support international collaboration, and help shape how the backbone of 1KOMMA5°s software landscape executes its mission.
 Your Responsibilities: 
 Central Coordination: Act as point of contact within the organization. Connecting teams, ensuring effective information flow, and coordinating alignment across departments and international stakeholders.
 People & Culture: Drive the department’s growth by playing a key role in hiring, onboarding new talent, and organizing team events and workshops to maintain a world-class culture.
 Stakeholder Communication: Prepare high-impact reports and presentations for the C-Level and investors and bridge the gap between tech-heavy internal teams and our business partners. You translate digital solutions into tangible value.
 Project Leadership and Execution: Lead and coordinate strategic and operational projects with cross-functional and international impact. Drive initiatives from concept to delivery and ensure measurable outcomes.
 Data & Operational Excellence: Master our internal data landscape to track KPIs, follow up on action items, and ensure that departmental goals are met on time.
 Support for the Leadership Team: Provide direct support to C-Level and VPs in day-to-day operations, strategic planning, and administrative tasks including project preparation, documentation, and coordination.
Your profile
 Educational Background: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably with a focus on Tech, Product, or Business.
 Professional Experience: You have 2+ years of experience in a high-growth startup, consulting, or a demanding project management environment.
 Analytical Mindset: You are highly structured and data-driven, with the ability to turn raw information into actionable strategies.
 Relationship Builder: You have a natural ability to build trust across different departments, from software engineers to operational teams.
 Startup Resilience: You thrive in fast-paced environments, possess a proactive "get things done" mindset, and can make high-quality decisions under pressure.
 Tools & Skills: You are a power user of Google Sheets/Slides (and other analytics tools) and have an excellent command of both German and English .
 Mission-Driven: You are genuinely motivated by the mission of accelerating the global energy transition.
 Bonus points for:
 Previous experience in the Energy Sector.
 Experience with programming or advanced data analytics tools (SQL, Python, or BI tools).
Benefits
 You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
 With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
 Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
 You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
 You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
 You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
 Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
 Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: Terminology Project Manager (x/f/m)
description:
SET A NEW PULSE FOR HEALTHCARE!
We are looking for a Terminology Project Manager to join the Medical Excellence team in Berlin.
As a Terminology Project Manager, your mission will be to contribute to the delivery of medical initiatives with a direct public health impact. Working closely with our Global Medical Data Program Manager, you will play a pivotal role in revolutionising healthcare through the power of data — driving our mission to transform medical data management and interoperability in Germany.
This is a full time position with a one year contract (parental leave replacement).
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
 - Deliver adjusted terminologies to support new product launches and features
 - Build comprehensive terminologies for both patients and healthcare professionals, ensuring unified workflows across our products
 - Develop tools (Python programs and AI prompts) to support your work
 - Collaborate with external medical experts to validate the relevance and usability of chosen terminologies
 - Analyse product manager needs and work closely with Tech teams to understand technical constraints
 - Write terminology documentation and communicate on your work across stakeholders
WHO YOU ARE
Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.
You could be our next team mate if you have:
 - Experience in Data and Interoperability Projects: experience in data, terminology or interoperability projects in Germany. Whether you are an expert or have a strong project management background, your experience will be invaluable in driving our projects forward.
 - Experience in the Medical field: you have a medical background from medical studies or a previous experience in a medical company.
 - Structured and Analytical Mindset: You thrive in structured environments and possess a strong analytical mindset. Your ability to break down complex problems and develop effective solutions will be instrumental in ensuring the success of our medical data initiatives.
 - Detail-Oriented and Inquisitive: You have a keen eye for detail and enjoy delving deep into topics. Your meticulous approach will ensure the accuracy and quality of our medical data management processes.
 - Result and Action-Oriented: You are driven by results and possess strong project management skills. Your ability to set clear goals, prioritize tasks, and drive projects to completion will be essential in achieving our objectives.
 - User-Centric: You genuinely care about the end-users of your work. By putting the needs of our users at the forefront, you will contribute to the development of user-centric medical data solutions that enhance the healthcare experience.
 - Excellent Communication Skills: Your exceptional communication skills enable you to effectively collaborate with teams from diverse backgrounds, including medical professionals, software developers, and data scientists. You are able to articulate complex technical challenges in simple terms.
 - Fluent in German and English: You are fluent in both German and English, enabling you to communicate effortlessly in both languages. Proficiency in Italian or French is a plus, further enhancing your ability to collaborate with a diverse team.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib
 - 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)
 - Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
 - Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz
 - Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)
 - The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more
 - Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care http://Moka.care
 - Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club
 - A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode
 - Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit
 - For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
THE INTERVIEW PROCESS
 - Interview with Hiring Manager
 - Case Study
 - At least one reference check
JOB DETAILS
 - Fixed term contract (Parental leave replacement)
 - Full Time
 - Workplace: Berlin mandatory
 - Hybrid work setup (2 remote days per week)
 - Start date: January 2027
At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.
The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.
To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.
Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Über FLIZ 
 FLIZpay ist eine deutsche Zahlungsmethode, mit der Unternehmen die Kosten der Zahlungsabwicklung radikal senken und mit der Kundinnen und Kunden beim Bezahlen sparen. Statt Kartendaten zu speichern, hinterlegen Shopper ihr Bankkonto sicher und bezahlen mit der FLIZ App bei teilnehmenden Händlern. Händler behalten die Ersparnis oder setzen sie für Cashback und Rabatte ein, die Conversion und Kundenbindung stärken. In Deutschland entwickelt, für Europa gemacht: eine lokale Alternative zu den internationalen Zahlungsnetzwerken, bei der Kundendaten in der EU bleiben.
 Wir sind Seed-Stage, sitzen in Berlin und arbeiten im regulierten Zahlungsumfeld. Ein cross-funktionales Team baut und betreibt alles: Checkout, Händler-Plugins, -SDK oder -API, FLIZ App und unsere Business-Plattform. Vier eigenständige Produkte sind live, weitere kommen.
 Deine Rolle bei FLIZ 
 Du arbeitest direkt mit unserer Head of Product und machst aus Vision und Strategie fertiges Produkt. Das ist eine Hands-on-Rolle mitten im Team: Du sitzt neben Design und Engineering, nicht drei Ebenen entfernt, und übernimmst vom ersten Tag an echte Probleme.
 Das Tempo unterschätzen die meisten. Initiativen, die wir vor zwei Jahren auf acht bis zehn Wochen geschätzt hätten, gehen heute in unter zwei Wochen live. Kleinere Dinge schaffen es an einem Tag von der Idee in die Produktion. KI ist von Research über Prototyping bis Delivery überall im Spiel, und die Produktrolle hat sich damit verändert. Du lernst, wie Product Management 2026 wirklich funktioniert.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Payment-Produkte
 Übersetzung von Business-Zielen in eine klare Product Roadmap
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Tech, Design und Business
 Priorisierung von Features basierend auf Impact, Daten und Nutzerfeedback
 Definition von KPIs und kontinuierliche Optimierung
 Entwicklung und Ownership der übergeordneten Produktstrategie
 Enge Abstimmung mit Foundern, Tech und Stakeholdern
 Skalierung von Produktprozessen (Discovery, Delivery, Analytics)
 Verantwortung für Produktvision, Roadmap und Performance
 Wer du bist 
 Das bringst du mit
 Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend.
 3+ Jahre (PM)
 Erfahrung in einem Startup oder dynamischen Umfeld
 Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise
 Technisches Grundverständnis (APIs, Plattformen, Integrationen)
 Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Entscheidungsstärke
 Idealerweise verfügst du außerdem über
 Erfahrung im FinTech-, Payment- oder SaaS-Umfeld
 Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. PSD2, KYC, AML)
 Erfahrung im Aufbau von Produktteams
 Warum FLIZ 
 Spannende Herausforderungen mit echtem Mehrwert: Die Möglichkeit, an anspruchsvollen Aufgaben zu arbeiten und mit deiner Arbeit einen spürbaren Beitrag zum Unternehmenserfolg zu leisten.
 Ein engagiertes Team: Zusammenarbeit mit motivierten, leistungsorientierten Kollegen, die sich mit Leidenschaft für unsere gemeinsame Mission einsetzen.
 Attraktive Vergütung: Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt sowie die Möglichkeit einer Unternehmensbeteiligung durch Aktienoptionen.
 Persönliches Umfeld: Gemeinsame Arbeit in unserem zentralen Büro in Berlin und bei Bedarf auch remote.
 KI-natives Arbeiten: Alles, was ein Agent kann, musst du nicht selbst tun.
 Kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Ebenen, echte Verantwortung von Anfang an.

title: Associate Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Purpose of Position 
 Our Product Team is looking for a passionate and dedicated colleague to join them and build world-class products to move the performance marketing industry forward.
 In this role, you will work closely with both internal and external developers to build plugins, connectors and other integrations including with e-commerce and customer data platforms. You will support the product backlog management and ensure that our products meet customer needs and business objectives.
 This is an exciting role where you will build and maintain a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape and industry trends.
 If you care about delivering products that customers love, enjoy working with different cultures, and meeting people from around the world, this position is a great opportunity for you. Join our team at our Product Hubs in Berlin , London, or Milan, or work from another country where Awin has an office.
 What you'll be responsible for: 
 In this role, you will collaborate with product managers to manage the backlog.
 You will liaise between internal and external engineers, the UX team, and stakeholders to ensure clear communication of product requirements.
 You will monitor product performance metrics and generate reports to support data-driven decision making.
 You will partner with customer-facing teams to gather customer feedback and insights, and use that feedback to inform product development decisions
 You will identify opportunities with product peers to further add value to our plugins and various platform integrations
 You will work with the Product Marketing team to communicate releases and drive adoption of existing and new products
 You will develop and maintain a deep understanding of the e-commerce, customer-data platform landscape, and industry trends to inform product strategy for platform integrations
 Your Skills 
 You have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
 You have first experience or curiosity about working in product development
 You have experience or high-level understanding of Ecommerce or similar platforms
 You are comfortable with web technologies
 You are data driven and possess analytical and problem-solving skills
 You are comfortable in communicating with multiple stakeholders
 You are self-motivated, organised, capable of prioritising work and focusing on important tasks
 Our Offer 
 Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
 Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.

 Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
 Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
 Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme. 
 We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview. 
 Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.
 Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.
 Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.
 Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why
 Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d)
description:
At Pflegia we build and operate an intelligent job matching platform that brings caregivers and healthcare employers together. Our vision is to become Europe's leading job platform for nursing professions and to fight the nursing crisis.
We are past the build-it phase. The constraint is no longer whether we can ship — it is deciding which of twenty possible things actually moves hires. That decision is the job. Become part of the team and shape the nursing job market with us.
 Tasks
 What You'll Do
 Own the matching funnel end to end — invite, accepted match, transferred match, interview, hire. Every step is measured today and every step leaks.
 Analyze business requirements and break them down into roadmaps, timelines, epics, tickets and tasks — and defend the cut list.
 Document, analyze and improve the whole user journey on both sides of the marketplace: candidates and employers have competing interests, and those trade-offs are yours to make rather than escalate.
 Create actionable concepts for new products and features, estimate effort and ROI, own the process from ideation to delivery.
 Decide where AI belongs and where it does not. Run experiments with the expected outcome written down first, then verify and iterate.
 Define KPIs, track them, improve them, revise them. Within 90 days we expect one metric you moved, with a baseline, a number, and a read you can defend to the leadership team.
 Collaborate with stakeholders, developers and the data team, and use data-driven storytelling to align them.
 Requirements
 Must have
 5+ years in Product Ownership/Management, shipping with cross-functional agile teams.
 Experience building or scaling marketplaces, job boards, or recruitment platforms — two-sided funnels behave differently and we would rather not teach that from scratch.
 Data-driven by default: you write your own analytics questions, read an experiment result, and say "this did not work" out loud. Analytics, A/B testing, experimentation and you can name a business number your product work moved, its baseline, and why you picked that problem over the next one.
 Technical depth: you have worked closely with engineers on complex products and can read, question and push back on an architecture, an API contract or a data flow. Engineering trade-offs are product decisions you make, not ones you hand on.
 Strong ability to define product vision, roadmaps and priorities against business goals, customer needs and technical constraints — including clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria for complicated workflows and funnels.
 Excellent written German and English. Our users, employers and support team are German-speaking; our codebase and documentation are English.
 Nice to have
 Search and SEO, including the AI-answer variants (AIEO, AEO, GEO) — a growing share of our traffic.
 Matching or recommendation systems: you know why offline metrics and business metrics disagree.
 Healthcare hiring workflows and empathy for the field — shift work, qualification recognition, and why a nurse does not read email at 14:00.
 SQL. Not required, but the people who enjoy this role usually have it.
 Benefits
 Decision authority. Flat hierarchies with short decision paths are not a slogan here: you will not need a committee to ship, and you will not get to blame one either.
 Direct access to the data — our own data lake, dashboards and product analytics. You query it yourself instead of filing a ticket and waiting.
 Budget and room for experiments that are allowed to fail, provided the expected outcome was defined up front.
 Regular feedback conversations with empathic and experienced leadership.
 An open corporate culture with helpful, communicative colleagues and a genuinely cooperative working atmosphere.
 Central Berlin office in a beautiful old building, plus flexible remote

title: Product Manager (UK Market)
description:
About Us
 Founded in Berlin, autarc is a ~75 person start-up who were part of Y Combinator's S24 batch in San Francisco. Our team consists of people in Sales, Tech and Operations.
 Your Impact
 autarc is established in the UK: a significant number of UK installers already run their heat pump and solar business on autarc. The market is accelerating: the Boiler Upgrade Scheme now pays £9,000 towards a heat pump, applications hit a record in 2026 and the Warm Homes Plan targets 450,000 heat pumps per year by 2030.
We know this market in depth. MCS for heat pumps and solar, DNO notifications under G98 and G99, BUS vouchers and MID registration are built into how we work and what we ship. Your job is to take that depth further and turn every new insight from the field into product. You join a team of 7 product managers that works very closely with our CEO.
You will dig deep into the technical detail, but you are a pragmatist at heart: you turn what you learn into product fast. We ship every day, and that is the speed we need.
This is a builder role: you prototype, vibe code and connect APIs yourself, and work with our product teams on everything bigger. With an existing customer base, you create impact from week one.
We are an extremely fast-growing venture, and a large part of this role happens at our customers. You will spend a lot of time on the road across the UK: in installers' offices, on site and at trade events.
Your responsibilities include:
 Join UK sales calls and demos weekly and turn what you hear into a prioritised list of missing features
 Drive UK localisation end to end: MCS heat pump design and installation (MIS 3005-D/I, MCS 020), solar (MIS 3002), MID and handover documentation
 Go deep on the grid side: G98/G99, DNO notifications for heat pumps and EV chargers, export limitation, plus BUS and the Warm Homes Plan
 Build prototypes, tools and integrations yourself with AI coding tools and our APIs
 Get UK requirements onto the roadmaps of our product teams and drive them to release
 Know UK installers, partners and competitors in detail and own UK product KPIs such as sellability
 What You Bring
 2+ years in product management, a technical role or as a founder in a fast-moving startup
 Deep understanding of UK renewables, or the ability to get there fast: MCS, DNO processes and BUS are your daily language
 Technical depth, pragmatic execution. You enjoy working through technical and regulatory detail, and you get it into the product quickly instead of perfecting it on paper. We ship every day
 You are AI-pilled. You use AI for everything, follow what is happening and get excited by new models and tools
 You build things yourself. You have vibe coded real tools or apps and can show us what you made
 Comfortable with APIs and data models: you can read API docs and wire up an integration prototype on your own
 Founder-level drive. You do not expect a team to wait for your specs. You push things forward yourself until they are live
 Commercially minded: you enjoy sales calls and can tell a real need from a nice-to-have
 You want to work hard. We work long hours with high intensity. If work-life balance is your top priority right now, this role is not the right fit
 You love being on the road. You are excited to travel across the UK regularly and spend real time with customers in their offices and on site
 Fluent in English, German is a plus
 Big plus:
 You are an ex-founder and have built and sold a product from zero
 You know the UK installer world, e.g. from an MCS-certified installer, a manufacturer or software for the trades
 What We Offer
 Ownership of a new product area with real impact on the energy transition
 Direct work with the founders on strategy, pricing and partnerships
 Low ego, high trust: No blame, open feedback, collaboration over hierarchy.
 Be part of the energy transition: Help bring more heat pumps and solar to homes every day.
 Modern equipment: MacBook and 27″ monitor.
 Annual team retreat plus regular team events.
 Mobility: Dance e-bike or Deutschland-Ticket.
 When it gets late: Your dinner via Uber Eats and your taxi home are on us.
 Fitness: Urban Sports Club membership.
 Next steps
 If your application is successful, you will participate in the following:
 Culture fit call
 Product case: how you would shape autarc's UK product
 Final on-site interview with the CEO and the team
 About Us
 Heating our buildings causes around 25% of Europe's CO₂ emissions. Decarbonizing it depends on installers – and there are far too few of them to keep up with the growing demand for heat pumps.
autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe: software that makes planning, designing and installing heat pumps faster and more digital. Our goal is to help plan and design 1 million heat pumps by 2030.
Founded in Berlin and backed by Y Combinator (S24), we're a team of 60+ people across Sales, Tech and Operations, already serving more than 2,000 customers.

title: Technical Product Manager - Core Workout Experience (m/f/d)
description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of fitness technology? As a Technical Product Manager (m/f/d), you will take ownership of the core functionality services and user-facing features that enhance our training experience ecosystem. Join us in Munich or Berlin and be part of a talented, innovative team!
 Your daily workout
 Ownership: You take responsibility for maintaining and developing EGYM’s core training services and key features supporting our ecosystem
 Collaboration: You report to the Workout Experience Tribe Lead, and work closely with the Product Managers from the ecosystem, UX designers/researchers, engineers, sports scientists, data scientists, and diverse stakeholders

title: Technical Product Owner (w/m/d) – Software & Full Stack Applications
description:
**AI macht uns schneller. Das Denken nimmt sie uns nicht ab.** 
**Was AI produziert, überprüfen wir. Für alles, was rausgeht, stehen wir gerade.** 
**Beim Ausprobieren sind wir schnell, beim Ausliefern gründlich.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
**Deine Mission**
-----------------
Du verstehst Business-Anforderungen und kannst sie mit technischem Denken in konkrete Lösungen übersetzen. Du weißt, welche Fragen geklärt werden müssen, bevor etwas entwickelt wird, und worauf es ankommt, damit aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Feature wird.
Als **Technical Product Owner (f/m/d)** bist du Teil unseres Engineering Teams und arbeitest eng mit Entwicklern und Business Stakeholdern zusammen. Du sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen verstanden, Lösungen durchdacht und Features sauber umgesetzt werden. Dabei behältst du sowohl das große Ganze als auch die technischen Details im Blick.
* **Bring Anforderungen auf den Punkt.** Du sprichst mit den Business Stakeholdern, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist. Daraus entwickelst du verständliche User Stories, technische Tickets und konkrete Akzeptanzkriterien, mit denen das Engineering Team zielführend arbeiten kann.
* **Behalte den technischen Überblick.** Du verstehst, wie Frontend, Backend, APIs und Datenbanken zusammenspielen. So kannst du technische Zusammenhänge nachvollziehen, Abhängigkeiten erkennen und gemeinsam mit den Entwicklern passende Lösungen finden.
* **Teste selbst, statt dich auf Annahmen zu verlassen.** Du prüfst APIs, validierst Daten und führst Acceptance- und Smoke-Tests durch. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, gehst du der Sache auf den Grund, grenzt Fehler ein und sorgst dafür, dass Probleme nachvollziehbar gelöst werden.
* **Bring die Umsetzung voran.** Du koordinierst die anstehenden Aufgaben im Team, klärst offene Fragen und behältst Abhängigkeiten im Blick. Du begleitest Features von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Go-live.
* **Übernimm Verantwortung über den Go-live hinaus.** Wir entwickeln und betreiben unsere Anwendungen selbst. Dazu gehören auch Maintenance, Fehleranalyse, Monitoring und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen. Du behältst die technische Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit im Blick und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team dafür, dass unsere Anwendungen langfristig funktionieren und weiterentwickelt werden.
**Deine Skills**
----------------
Du musst nicht selbst Software programmieren. Aber du solltest verstehen, wie Software entsteht, technische Zusammenhänge erkennen und dich mit Entwicklern auf Augenhöhe austauschen können.
* **Du denkst technisch und produktorientiert.** Du verstehst fachliche Anforderungen, hinterfragst sie und übersetzt sie in konkrete User Stories, technische Tickets und aussagekräftige Akzeptanzkriterien.
* **Du verstehst moderne Webanwendungen.** Du weißt, wie Frontend, Backend, APIs und Datenbanken zusammenspielen. REST-APIs sind dir vertraut und du hast praktische Erfahrung damit, Endpunkte zu testen, Responses zu analysieren und Daten zu validieren.
* **Du kennst moderne Entwicklungsprozesse.** Git, Branches, Commits, Pull Requests und Merges sind dir vertraut. Du verstehst, wie Software entwickelt, getestet und ausgerollt wird.
* **Du denkst über den Go-live hinaus.** Du hast ein Verständnis für Monitoring, Performance, Stabilität und Maintenance und weißt, worauf es beim zuverlässigen Betrieb von Anwendungen ankommt.
* **Du arbeitest strukturiert und kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe.** Du erkennst Details und Abhängigkeiten, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst technische und fachliche Perspektiven zusammen. Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig, sorgfältig und lösungsorientiert.
**Das ist ein Plus:**
* Erfahrung mit Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Jira oder vergleichbaren Tools.
* Background in QA, Software Testing, technischer Business Analyse oder Softwareentwicklung.
* Kenntnisse in Monitoring und Observability, beispielsweise Grafana, Prometheus oder Graylog.
* Erfahrung mit Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS oder GCP sowie mit DevOps oder CI/CD.
* Erfahrung mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen oder Coding Agents.
* Erfahrung in agilen Softwareentwicklungsteams.
**Unser Stack**
---------------
Wir entwickeln, betreiben und verbessern moderne Full-Stack-Anwendungen. Dabei setzen wir auf einen JavaScript-basierten Technologie-Stack und beschäftigen uns intensiv damit, wie AI unsere Entwicklung und unsere Produkte weiterbringen kann.
* **Frontend:** React, TypeScript
* **Backend:** Node.js
* **APIs:** REST
* **Datenbanken:** SQL
* **Development & Collaboration:** Forgejo, Jira
* **Infrastructure & Monitoring:** AWS, GCP, Grafana, Graylog
**AI & Development:** Eigene GPU-Infrastruktur, Open-Weight-Modelle verschiedener Anbieter und AI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge wie OpenCode.
Du musst nicht jede Technologie im Detail kennen. Wichtig ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst, Bestehendes kritisch hinterfragst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest.
**Was dich bei uns erwartet**
-----------------------------

title: Senior Technical Programme Manager
description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
 What You'll Do
 Build and maintain sufficient understanding of the underlying technology to challenge constructively, identify delivery implications, and represent technical status accurately. The role is not expected to act as the technical authority.
 Translate customer requirements, contractual obligations, and engineering inputs into clear delivery plans, milestones, priorities, and actionable work packages.
 Own the day-to-day delivery of defence programmes or significant technical workstreams, ensuring agreed scope, schedule, quality, and delivery objectives are achieved.
 Work closely with engineering teams to understand the technical scope, maturity, progress, risks, and constraints of underlying engineering activity.
 Coordinate cross-functional delivery across engineering, operations, quality, commercial, and external suppliers.
 Prepare clear, concise programme materials, including status reports, decision papers, review packs, and customer updates, that support timely, high-quality decisions.
 Support and coordinate technical reviews, technical discussions, and reporting; ensure actions, decisions, and technical dependencies are captured and closed.
 Work directly with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders in delivery meetings, programme reviews, and technical discussions.
 Manage day-to-day relationships with technical partners and subcontractors, coordinating deliverables, resolving technical queries, and holding suppliers to agreed schedule and quality expectations.
 Ensure applicable safety, quality, assurance, and regulatory frameworks are understood and appropriately integrated into programme delivery. Work with relevant technical and assurance authorities to ensure compliance requirements, verification activities, and evidence needs are planned and tracked.
 Who You Are
 At least 5 years’ experience in programme or project delivery within aerospace, defence, engineering, deep-tech, or another high-consequence technical environment.
 A degree or comparable professional background in engineering, physics, materials science, systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
 Demonstrable experience working between technical detail and programme execution, converting analysis into practical delivery action.
 Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment
 Exposure to customer-facing delivery, programme reviews, supplier management, or subcontractor coordination.
 Experience with planning, risk management, dependency management, change control, and delivery reporting.
 Fluent English, with confidence operating in bilingual and cross-cultural settings. German is not a requirement, but is preferred.
 What We Offer
 A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 
 Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, defence, and business functions, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 
 High ownership and autonomy; no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 
 A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly and broken processes are fixed rather than tolerated. 
 A culture that values clarity, integrity, excellence, and direct feedback. 
 Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 
 At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Project Manager (f/m/d) – Service & Repair (Gas Turbine Components)
description:
Momentaufnahme von Ihrem Tag 
 Als Projektmanager (w/m/d) steuern Sie die Versorgung komplexer Heißgaskomponenten für den weltweiten Gasturbinen-Service. Sie arbeiten eng mit internationalen Lieferanten, internen Kunden sowie technischen und kaufmännischen Fachbereichen zusammen und koordinieren Qualität, Termine, Kosten und Materialverfügbarkeit. Dabei treiben Sie nachhaltige Refurbishment-Projekte voran, optimieren Lieferketten und sorgen für eine effiziente Projektabwicklung. Ihr Arbeitsalltag verbindet Projektmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Lieferantensteuerung und technische Bewertung in einem internationalen Umfeld der Energie- und Turbinenindustrie.
 Wie Sie etwas bewirken können 
 Eigenverantwortliche Leitung komplexer internationaler Material- und Refurbishment-Projekte für kritische Gasturbinenkomponenten einschließlich Termin-, Kosten-, Risiko- und Ergebnisverantwortung.
 Entwicklung und Umsetzung nachhaltiger Material- und Versorgungsstrategien sowie Beratung interner Kunden bei technischen, wirtschaftlichen und projektspezifischen Entscheidungen zur Sicherstellung der langfristigen Versorgungssicherheit.
 Steuerung globaler Lieferketten einschließlich Eskalationsmanagement, Priorisierung kritischer Bedarfe, Expediting sowie Sicherstellung anspruchsvoller Qualitäts-, Kosten- und Lieferziele.
 Durchführung technischer und wirtschaftlicher Analysen zur Optimierung von Beständen, Materialflüssen, Budgets und Ressourcen sowie Ableitung entsprechender Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.
 Verantwortung für die technische Bewertung, Verwendungsentscheidung und Lebenszyklusstrategie hochwertiger Gasturbinenkomponenten unter Berücksichtigung von Betriebsdaten, Bauteilzustand und Wirtschaftlichkeit.
 Entwicklung und Steuerung eines internationalen Lieferantennetzwerks einschließlich Lieferantenqualifizierung, Kapazitätsmanagement, Performance Reviews sowie kontinuierlicher Lieferantenentwicklung.
 Was Sie mitbringen 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Produktionstechnik, Energietechnik oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung.
 Langjährige Berufserfahrung und fundierte Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Einkauf oder Servicegeschäft eines Industrieunternehmens.
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office sowie fortgeschrittene Anwenderkenntnisse in SAP ERP oder vergleichbaren ERP-Systemen
 Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
 Fundierte Kenntnisse im Risiko-, Stakeholder- und Lieferantenmanagement sowie in der Entwicklung strategischer Versorgungskonzepte.
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Kunden, Lieferanten und Management-Stakeholdern.
 Über das Team 
 Unser Geschäftsbereich Gas Services bietet emissionsarme Stromerzeugung durch Service und Dekarbonisierung. Emissionsfreie oder emissionsarme Stromerzeugung und alle Gasturbinen unter einem Dach, Dampfturbinen und Generatoren. Dekarbonisierungschancen durch Serviceangebote, Modernisierung und Digitalisierung der Flotte.
 Wer ist Siemens Energy? 
 Wir bei Siemens Energy sind mehr als nur ein Energietechnologieunternehmen. Mit ~100,000 engagierten Mitarbeitern in mehr als 90 Ländern entwickeln wir die Energiesysteme der Zukunft und stellen sicher, dass der wachsende Energiebedarf der Weltgemeinschaft zuverlässig und nachhaltig gedeckt wird. Die in unseren Forschungsabteilungen und Fabriken entstehenden Technologien treiben die Energiewende voran und bilden die Grundlage für ein Sechstel der weltweiten Stromerzeugung.
Unser globales Team setzt sich dafür ein, nachhaltige, zuverlässige und bezahlbare Energie Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen, indem es die Grenzen des Möglichen immer weiter hinausschiebt. Wir blicken zurück auf eine 150-jährige Tradition der Innovation, die unsere Suche nach Mitarbeitern bestärkt, die unseren Fokus auf Dekarbonisierung, neue Technologien und Energiewandel unterstützen.
Hier erfahren Sie, wie Sie bei Siemens Energy etwas bewirken können: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Unser Engagement für Vielfalt 
 Gut, dass wir nicht alle gleich sind. Vielfalt macht uns leistungsstark. Wir leben von Inklusion und unsere gemeinsame kreative Energie wird von über 130 Nationalitäten gespeist. Siemens Energy setzt auf den Charakter - unabhängig von ethnischem Hintergrund, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Identität oder Behinderung. Wir versorgen die Gesellschaft mit Energie - die ganze Gesellschaft - und wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von Unterschieden, die zwischen uns bestehen.
 Benefits
 Neben einem attraktiven, marktgerechten Vergütungspaket erwartet Sie eine attraktive arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersversorgung
 Daneben bieten wir die Möglichkeit, zu sehr interessanten Mitarbeiterkonditionen Aktionär*in von Siemens Energy zu werden
 Unter unserem Motto #BetterTogether bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, flexibel und auch remote zu arbeiten. Aber auch unsere Büros lassen keine Wünsche offen und bieten Raum für inspirierende Zusammenarbeit und Kreativität
 Die berufliche und auch persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein großes Anliegen. Sie haben bei uns die Möglichkeit selbstbestimmt zu lernen und sich zu entwickeln. Dafür stehen unterschiedliche attraktive Programme und Maßnahmen zur Verfügung
 Unter dem Aspekt "Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf" haben wir ein vielfältiges Angebot, z.B. flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Kinderbetreuungsplätze an vielen Standorten, die Möglichkeit zur Schnupperteilzeit oder auch ein Sabbatical 
 Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit, deswegen sind Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung ausdrücklich gewollt.

The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
Forbes Advisor is hiring! We are searching for a Senior Product Manager who will play a pivotal role in scaling our business formation and management platform.
Reporting to the Head of Product, SMB, you’ll own new product and platform development across the portfolio. You’ll be responsible for identifying new service opportunities, building from concept to launch, scaling our platforms to support new use-cases and exponential customer growth, and automating core operational workflows that power our business. You’ll collaborate closely with senior stakeholders, customers, and cross-functional teams to drive product discovery, development, and delivery. This is an exciting opportunity to lead and influence the key areas of our business while working in an environment that values innovation, creativity, and adaptability.
 Responsibilities
 Lead 0-to-1 product discovery and delivery, taking new service offerings from early hypothesis through customer validation, MVP, and scaled launch. 
 Identify and evaluate new product and service opportunities across the customer journey, including scoping market size, customer demand, the competitive landscape, and unit economics to inform what to build next. 
 Optimize and scale the core platform to support new use cases, additional product lines, and exponential customer growth. 
 Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, analytics, and commercial, to deliver best-in-class product experiences from concept through to release and beyond. 
 Design and automate core operational workflows that power the business, reducing friction and unit costs while improving customer experience and unlocking throughput. 
 Partner with sales, LCM, marketing, and partnership teams to define GTM strategy, inform product decisions, and validate demand, to accelerate product-market fit and achieve commercial targets. 
 Define and manage a structured product backlog. Clearly prioritise initiatives based on impact, resource availability, and strategic alignment, while staying responsive to new information. 
 Track performance across key metrics post-launch, identifying areas of improvement and driving iterative enhancements post-launch. 
 Act as the central point of communication across the business for your product area, ensuring transparency, managing stakeholder expectations, and aligning on shared outcomes. 
 Play a key role in refining product development practices across the team, bringing experience, structure, and a proactive mindset to each challenge. 
 Qualifications
 6+ years of experience in product management, with a strong track record of building 0-1 products and evolving platforms to support customer and product-line growth. 
 Experience designing and launching workflow automations, operational tooling, or integrations that materially reduce cost or improve throughput at scale. 
 Deep empathy for small business users and experience designing products for SMBs, solopreneurs, or individual business owners making high-consideration decisions. 
 Confident working across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and definition to delivery and iteration. 
 Comfortable with SQL, product analytics tools (Google Analytics, Amplitude, or similar), and financial modeling. 
 Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing input from multiple stakeholders. 
 Data-driven, with the ability to define and track performance metrics, and use insights to inform decisions. 
 Excellent communication and storytelling skills, matched with proficiency in modern prototyping tools (e.g., Figma) to communicate ideas effectively across stakeholders. 
 Curious, collaborative, and proactive in identifying new opportunities or resolving blockers
